bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷三十七 唐書13: 明宗本紀三
title.en: Volume 37 Book of Later Tang 13: Mingzong Annals 3
title.raw: 卷三十七 唐書13: 明宗本紀三 Volume 37 Book of Later Tang 13: Mingzong Annals 3

sentences.zh: 天成元年秋八月乙酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, yiyou new moon of Tiancheng 1, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the eighth month of Tiancheng 1 there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「莊宗廟室酌獻，請奏武成之舞。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "For Zhuangzong's temple chamber libation offering, we ask to perform the Wucheng dance.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual offices asked to perform the Wucheng dance at Zhuangzong's libation offering.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 鄆州節度使霍彥威移鎮青州。

translations.literal: Yanzhou military commissioner Huo Yanwei was transferred to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Huo Yanwei moved from Yan to Qing as military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，莊宗神主祔廟，有司請祧懿祖室，從之。

translations.literal: On dinghai Zhuangzong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the temple; the relevant offices asked to remove the Yizu chamber, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhuangzong's tablet entered the temple; the court asked to retire the Yizu chamber and Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 詔：「陵州、合州長流百姓豆盧革、韋說等，可並自長流後，縱逢恩赦，不在原宥之限。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The long-exiled commoners Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He prefectures may, after their long exile ends, never be included in any amnesty restoration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict barred the long-exiled Dou Luge and Wei Shuo of Ling and He from ever benefiting from amnesty.

sentences.zh: 豆盧升、韋濤仍削除自前所受官秩。

translations.literal: Dou Lusheng and Wei Tao are still to be stripped of all offices and ranks previously held."
translations.idiomatic: Their sons Dou Lusheng and Wei Tao were also stripped of former offices and ranks."

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，以久雨，放百僚朝參，詔天下疏理係囚。

translations.literal: " On renchen, because of prolonged rain, the hundred officials' court attendance was suspended, and an edict ordered the realm to review prisoners in custody.
translations.idiomatic: " On renchen prolonged rain canceled court; Mingzong ordered a realm-wide review of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 甲午，汴州奏，舊管曹州乞卻歸當道，從之。

translations.literal: On jiawu Bianzhou reported that Cao Prefecture, formerly under its jurisdiction, asked to return to its proper circuit, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Bian asked that Cao, formerly under it, return to the circuit, and Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔曰：「承前使府奏請判官，率皆隨府除移停罷。

translations.literal: That day an edict said: "Under earlier practice, when military governors memorialized for staff judges, the judges were generally dismissed when the governor was transferred or removed.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict said staff judges had once followed their governor out of office.

sentences.zh: 近年流例，有異前規，使府雖已除移，判官元安舊職。

translations.literal: In recent years the custom differed from the old rule: though the governor had been transferred, the judge still held his former post.
translations.idiomatic: Lately judges had kept their posts after a governor moved.

sentences.zh: 起今後若是朝廷除授者，即不計使府除移，如是使府奏請，即皆隨府移罷。

translations.literal: Hereafter, if the appointment came from the court, the governor's transfer shall not matter; if the governor memorialized for the appointment, the judge shall leave when the governor moves.
translations.idiomatic: Court appointees would stay; governor-nominated judges would leave with the governor.

sentences.zh: 舊例藩侯帶平章事者，所奏請判官，殿中已上許奏緋，中丞已上許奏紫，今不帶平章事亦許同帶平章事例處分。

translations.literal: By old precedent, when a frontier lord held acting Grand Councillor rank, judges he memorialized for might wear scarlet from Palace Attendant up and purple from Vice Censor-in-Chief up; now even without acting Grand Councillor rank the same treatment is allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly only acting grand councillors could nominate judges for scarlet or purple dress; now the same applied without that rank.

sentences.zh: 如防禦、團練使奏請判官，員外郎已下不在奏緋之限。

translations.literal: For defense and training commissioners memorializing for judges, those below Vice Director of a Bureau are not within the scarlet memorial limit.
translations.idiomatic: Defense and training commissioners could not nominate judges below vice director for scarlet robes.

sentences.zh: 其所奏判官、州縣官，並須將曆任告身隨奏至京。

translations.literal: Judges and prefectural or county officials they memorialize for must all send past appointment patents with the memorial to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Nominated judges and local officials had to file past patents with the memorial.

sentences.zh: 如未有官，假稱試攝，亦奏狀內分明署出。

translations.literal: If they had no office yet but falsely claimed a provisional acting post, that too must be clearly stated in the memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Provisional acting posts had to be stated plainly in the memorial.

sentences.zh: 如藩鎮留後、權知軍州事，並不在奏請判官之限。

translations.literal: Acting military governors, regents, and those temporarily running a prefecture are not within the limit for memorializing judges.
translations.idiomatic: Regents and acting prefects could not nominate judges.

sentences.zh: 如刺史要奏州縣官，須申本道，請發表章，不得自奏。

translations.literal: If a prefect wished to memorialize for county officials, he had to report through his circuit and request a memorial from above, and might not memorialize on his own.
translations.idiomatic: Prefects had to route county nominations through the circuit, not submit them directly.

sentences.zh: 近日州使奏請從事，本無官緒，妄結虛銜，不計職位高卑，多是請兼朱紫，不惟紊亂，實啟撓求。

translations.literal: Recently prefectural envoys had memorialized for staff with no real office, inventing empty titles and, regardless of rank, mostly seeking concurrent scarlet and purple—not only disorderly but opening the door to importunity.
translations.idiomatic: Lately prefectural envoys had invented titles and sought scarlet and purple for staff with no real rank, inviting corruption.

sentences.zh: 宜令諸道州府，切準敕命處分。」

translations.literal: Let every circuit and prefecture strictly follow this edict."
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit and prefecture was ordered to follow the edict."

sentences.zh: 丁酉，內出象笏三十四面，賜百官之無笏者。

translations.literal: On dingyou thirty-four ivory tablets were issued from within the palace and given to officials who had none.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the palace issued thirty-four ivory court tablets to officials who lacked them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，帝御文明殿，百官入閣，月望如月朔之儀，從新例也。

translations.literal: On jihai the Emperor held court at Wenhua Hall; the hundred officials entered the inner gate, and the mid-month observance followed the new-moon rite—following the new precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Mingzong held court at Wenhua Hall; officials entered the inner gate for mid-month audience by the new-moon precedent.

sentences.zh: 荊南高季興上言，峽內三州，請朝廷不除刺史。

translations.literal: Jingnan's Gao Jixing memorialized that for the three prefectures within the gorges the court should not appoint prefects.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jixing of Jingnan asked that the court not appoint prefects to the three gorge prefectures.

sentences.zh: 幽州奏，契丹寇邊，詔齊州防禦使安審通率師禦之。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the Khitan were raiding the border; an edict ordered Qi Prefecture defense commissioner An Shentong to lead troops to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou reported Khitan border raids; Mingzong ordered An Shentong of Qi to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以前青州節度使符習為鄆州節度使，以前華州節度使史敬熔為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinchou former Qingzhou military commissioner Fu Xi was made Yanzhou military commissioner; former Huazhou military commissioner Shi Jingrong was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Fu Xi of Qing became Yan commissioner and Shi Jingrong of Hua became An commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禁熔錢為器，仍估定生銅器價斤二百，熟銅器斤四百，如違省價買賣者，以盜鑄錢論。

translations.literal: On yisi melting coin into vessels was forbidden; raw copper vessels were fixed at two hundred cash per jin and wrought copper at four hundred; violators who sold below the set price were to be punished as coin counterfeiters.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi coin-melting for utensils was banned; raw copper was fixed at 200 cash per jin and wrought at 400, with underpricing punished as counterfeiting.

sentences.zh: 丁未，樞密使院條奏：「諸道節度使、刺史內，有不守詔條，公行科斂，須行止絕。

translations.literal: On dingwei the Privy Council office submitted regulations: "Among military commissioners and prefects, those who do not keep edicts and openly levy illegal exactions must be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Privy Council submitted rules to stop illegal levies by commissioners and prefects.

sentences.zh: 州使所納軍糧，不得更邀加耗。

translations.literal: Army grain received by prefectural envoys must not be charged extra shrinkage.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectural envoys could not add shrinkage to army grain.

sentences.zh: 節度使、刺史所置牙隊，許於軍都內抽取，便給省司衣糧，況人數已多，訪問尚有招致。

translations.literal: Personal guards that commissioners and prefects raise may be drawn from the army command, with clothing and grain supplied by the provincial office; yet though the numbers are already large, inquiry shows they are still recruiting.
translations.idiomatic: Personal guards were to come from the army rolls with provincial pay, yet commissioners still kept recruiting beyond quota.

sentences.zh: 諸邑人多有抵罪亡命，便於州府投名為使下元隨，邀求職務，淩壓平人；

translations.literal: Many in the districts who owed crimes and fled as outlaws then enrolled with prefectures as personal followers, seeking posts and oppressing commoners;
translations.idiomatic: Fugitive criminals were enrolling as prefectural followers, seeking posts and bullying commoners;

sentences.zh: 及有力戶人，於諸處行賂，希求事務。

translations.literal: and powerful households bribed here and there hoping for office.
translations.idiomatic: and powerful households were bribing for office.

sentences.zh: 亦有州使安稱修葺城池廨宇，科賦於人，及營私宅，諸縣鎮所受州使文符，如涉科斂人戶，不得稟受。

translations.literal: Some prefectural envoys falsely claimed to repair city walls and offices, levying on the people, or built private houses; county and garrison officials receiving documents from the prefect that involved levying on households must not accept them.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys who taxed people for bogus repairs or private houses were barred, and counties could not accept their levy orders.

sentences.zh: 州府不得賒買行人物色，兼行科率。

translations.literal: Prefectures must not buy goods from traveling merchants on credit while also levying exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures could not buy on credit from merchants and levy at the same time.

sentences.zh: 已前條件，州使如敢犯違，許人陳告，勘詰不虛，量行獎賞。

translations.literal: On the foregoing, if a prefectural envoy dares violate them, informants are permitted; if investigation proves true, rewards shall be given according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: Violations could be reported; proven cases would bring rewards.

sentences.zh: 宜令三京、諸道州府，準此處分。」

translations.literal: Let the three capitals and every circuit and prefecture handle matters accordingly."
translations.idiomatic: The three capitals and all circuits were ordered to enforce the rules."

sentences.zh: 新授青州節度使霍彥威奏，處斬新登州刺史王公儼，及同謀拒命指揮使李謹、王居厚等八人訖。

translations.literal: The newly appointed Qingzhou military commissioner Huo Yanwei reported that he had executed the new Dengzhou prefect Wang Gongyan and eight others who had plotted rebellion, including commanders Li Jin and Wang Juhou.
translations.idiomatic: New Qing commissioner Huo Yanwei reported executing Deng prefect Wang Gongyan and eight plotters, including Li Jin and Wang Juhou.

sentences.zh: 初，同光中，符習為青州節度使，宦官楊希望為監軍，專製軍政。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Tongguang era Fu Xi was Qingzhou military commissioner and eunuch Yang Xiwang was army monitor, monopolizing military government.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongguang Fu Xi had held Qing while eunuch Yang Xiwang as monitor controlled the army.

sentences.zh: 趙在禮之據魏州，習奉詔以本軍進討，俄而帝為亂軍所劫，習即罷歸。

translations.literal: When Zhao Zaili seized Weizhou, Xi obeyed an edict and advanced with his army to attack; soon the Emperor was seized by mutinous troops and Xi withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Zaili took Wei, Fu Xi marched to attack, but Zhuangzong was seized by mutineers and Fu Xi withdrew.

sentences.zh: 希望遣兵邀之，習懼而還。

translations.literal: Xiwang sent troops to intercept him; Xi, afraid, turned back.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xiwang sent troops to cut him off; Fu Xi retreated in fear.

sentences.zh: 至滑州，帝遣人招之，習至，乃從帝入汴。

translations.literal: At Hua Prefecture the Emperor sent men to summon him; when Xi arrived he followed the Emperor into Bian.
translations.idiomatic: At Hua Zhuangzong summoned him; Fu Xi came and followed him into Bian.

sentences.zh: 希望聞魏軍亂，遣兵圍守習家，欲盡殺之。

translations.literal: Hearing the Wei army had mutinied, Xiwang sent troops to surround Xi's household intending to kill everyone.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing of the Wei mutiny, Yang Xiwang besieged Fu Xi's family to kill them all.

sentences.zh: 公儼素受希望獎愛，謂希望曰：「內侍宜分腹心之兵，監四面守陴者，則誰敢異圖。

translations.literal: Gongyan had long been favored by Xiwang and said to him, "Your Grace should divide your trusted troops to watch all four sides of the ramparts—then who would dare plot differently.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyan, favored by Yang Xiwang, urged him to post trusted troops on all four walls so no one could plot.

sentences.zh: 」希望從之。

translations.literal: " Xiwang followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " Yang Xiwang agreed.

sentences.zh: 公儼乘其無備，圍希望之第，擒而殺之。

translations.literal: Gongyan took him unawares, surrounded Xiwang's residence, seized him, and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyan surprised him, surrounded his house, seized Yang Xiwang, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 公儼遂與州將李謹等謀據州城，以邀符節，即令軍府飛章留己，兼揚言符習在鎮，人不便其政，帝乃除公儼為登州刺史。

translations.literal: Gongyan then with prefectural officers Li Jin and others plotted to hold the prefectural city to demand the commission, had the military government send a flying memorial to keep himself in post, and also spread word that while Fu Xi was in the prefecture the people found his rule hard; the Emperor then appointed Gongyan Dengzhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyan and Li Jin seized the city, memorialized to keep the post, and claimed Fu Xi's rule was unpopular; Zhuangzong named him Deng prefect.

sentences.zh: 公儼不時赴任，即以霍彥威代符習，聚兵淄州，以圖進取。

translations.literal: Gongyan did not promptly take office; Huo Yanwei replaced Fu Xi, massed troops at Zi Prefecture, and planned an advance.
translations.idiomatic: Gongyan delayed reporting; Huo Yanwei replaced Fu Xi, gathered troops at Zi, and prepared to advance.

sentences.zh: 彥威至淄州，會詔使至青州告諭，公儼即赴所任。

translations.literal: When Yanwei reached Zi, an edict envoy arrived at Qing to announce the matter, and Gongyan then went to his post.
translations.idiomatic: At Zi an envoy reached Qing with the court order, and Gongyan set out for his post.

sentences.zh: 彥威懲其初心，遣人擒公儼於北海縣，與同黨斬於州東。

translations.literal: Yanwei, punishing his original intent, sent men to seize Gongyan at Beihai County and with his accomplices beheaded him east of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yanwei seized Gongyan at Beihai and beheaded him and his party east of the city.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：彥威聚兵淄州，以圖進取，公儼懼。

translations.literal: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》: Yanwei massed troops at Zi Prefecture intending to advance; Gongyan was afraid.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says Yanwei concentrated at Zi to advance and Gongyan panicked.

sentences.zh: 乙未，始之官。

translations.literal: On yiwei he finally took office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he finally reported to his post.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，彥威至青州，追擒之。）〉

translations.literal: On dingyou Yanwei reached Qing and pursued and captured him.)〉
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Yanwei reached Qingzhou and arrested him.)〉

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「莊宗祔廟，懿祖祧遷，準例舍故而諱新，懿祖例不諱，忌日不行香。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized: "With Zhuangzong enshrined and Yizu removed, precedent calls for abandoning the old taboo and honoring the new; Yizu is by precedent not tabooed, and on his death day no incense is burned.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual offices said that with Zhuangzong enshrined and Yizu retired, the old taboo should yield to the new, but Yizu was not tabooed and needed no death-day incense.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，襄州節度使劉訓加檢校太傅，以偽蜀右僕射、中書侍郎、平章事、趙國公張格為太子賓客，充三司副使，從任圜請也。

translations.literal: On renzi Xiangzhou military commissioner Liu Xun was advanced to acting Grand Tutor; the false Shu Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, Vice Grand Councillor, and Duke of Zhao Zhang Ge was made Crown Prince Mentor and charged as deputy Three Offices commissioner—at Ren Yuan's request.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Xun of Xiang became acting grand tutor; false Shu minister Zhang Ge became crown prince mentor and deputy Three Offices commissioner at Ren Yuan's request.

sentences.zh: 九月乙卯朔，詔汴州扶溝縣復隸許州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yimao new moon: an edict returned Fugou County of Bian to Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the ninth month Mingzong returned Bian's Fugou County to Xu.

sentences.zh: 以前絳州刺史婁繼英為冀州刺史，充北面水陸轉運製置使。

translations.literal: Former Jiang prefect Lou Jiying was made Ji prefect and charged as northern land-and-water transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Jiying, former Jiang prefect, became Ji prefect and northern transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸至德宮，遂幸前隰州刺史袁建豐之第。

translations.literal: On jiwei the Emperor visited Zhide Palace, then visited the residence of former Xi prefect Yuan Jianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Mingzong visited Zhide Palace and then the home of former Xi prefect Yuan Jianfeng.

sentences.zh: 帝嘗為太原內牙親將，建豐為副，至是建豐風疾沈廢，故親幸其第以撫之。

translations.literal: The Emperor had once been a personal guard in the inner barracks at Taiyuan and Jianfeng his deputy; now Jianfeng was bedridden with wind illness, so the Emperor personally visited his house to comfort him.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong had served under Jianfeng in Taiyuan's inner guard; now Jianfeng lay crippled by stroke, so Mingzong visited to comfort him.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以都官郎中庾傳美充三州搜訪圖籍使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Capital Punishments Bureau director Yu Chuanmei was charged as commissioner to search the three prefectures for maps and records.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Yu Chuanmei of Capital Punishments was sent to search three prefectures for maps and archives.

sentences.zh: 傳美為蜀王衍之舊僚，家在成都，便於歸計，且言成都具有本朝實錄，及傳美使回，所得才九朝實錄及殘缺雜舊而已。

translations.literal: Chuanmei had been an old retainer of Shu ruler Wang Yan; his family was in Chengdu, which suited his plan to return, and he said Chengdu still held this dynasty's Veritable Records; when Chuanmei returned from his mission he obtained only the Veritable Records of nine reigns and miscellaneous damaged old texts.
translations.idiomatic: Chuanmei, once Wang Yan's retainer, had family in Chengdu and claimed the city still held Tang Veritable Records; his mission brought back only nine reigns' records and damaged old texts.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，應聖節，百僚於敬愛寺設齋，召緇黃之眾於中興殿講論，眾近例也。

translations.literal: On guihai, the Yingsheng festival, the hundred officials set a vegetarian feast at Jing'ai Temple and summoned monks and laity to discourse at Zhongxing Hall—following recent precedent.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Yingsheng day, officials held a feast at Jing'ai Temple and summoned clergy to Zhongxing Hall by recent precedent.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以偽蜀檢校太師、兼中書令、右金吾街使張貽範為兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On wuchen the false Shu acting Grand Master, concurrent Secretariat Director, Right Golden Crow Street commissioner Zhang Yifan was made War Minister and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen false Shu minister Zhang Yifan became War minister emeritus.

sentences.zh: 都官員外郎於鄴奏請指揮不得書契券輒賣良人，從之。

translations.literal: Capital Punishments Bureau vice director Yu Ye memorialized asking that orders forbid writing contracts that sold free persons, and it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Ye of Capital Punishments asked to forbid contracts selling free persons, and Mingzong agreed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，天策上將軍、湖南節度使、開府儀同三司、守太師、兼尚書令、楚王馬殷加檢校太師、守尚書令。

translations.literal: On guiyou Heaven's Strategy supreme general, Hunan military commissioner, Palace Opener, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Chu Ma Yin was advanced to acting Grand Preceptor and Grand Secretariat Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Ma Yin of Chu was advanced to acting grand preceptor and grand secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 兩浙節度留後、靜海軍節度、嶺南西道觀察處置等使、檢校太尉、兼中書令錢元瓘加食邑。

translations.literal: Liangzhe acting military commissioner, Jinghai army commissioner, Lingnan West observation commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanguan received added fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanguan of Liangzhe received added fief income.

sentences.zh: 中吳建武等軍節度、嶺南東道觀察處置等使、檢校太尉、兼中書令錢元尞加開府階，進食邑。

translations.literal: Zhongwu and Jianwu army military commissioner of central Wu, Lingnan East observation commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, and concurrent Secretariat Director Qian Yuanliao received opening-office rank and advanced fief income.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yuanliao of central Wu gained opening-office rank and added fief income.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以前代州刺史馬溉為左衛上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On jiaxu former Dai prefect Ma Gai was made Left Guard upper general and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Ma Gai, former Dai prefect, became Left Guard upper general emeritus.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以光祿卿羅周敬為右金吾衛大將軍，充街使。

translations.literal: On jimao Director of the Palace Supplies Luo Zhoujing was made Right Golden Crow guard great general and charged as street commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Luo Zhoujing of Palace Supplies became Right Golden Crow great general and street commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以前復州刺史袁{山義}為唐州刺史。

translations.literal: On xinsi former Fu prefect Yuan Yan was made Tang prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yuan Yan, former Fu prefect, became Tang prefect.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「鳳翔節度使李嚴，世聯宗屬，任重藩宣，慶善有稱，忠勤顯著。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Fengxiang military commissioner Li Yan is of our clan by marriage, bears heavy frontier responsibility, is praised for kindness, and shows marked loyalty and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: An edict praised Fengxiang commissioner Li Yan, a kinsman by marriage, for loyalty on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 既在維城之列，宜新定體之文。

translations.literal: Since he stands among those who shore up the realm, he should receive new forms of honor.
translations.idiomatic: As one who shored up the realm, he deserved new honors.

sentences.zh: 是降寵光，以隆惇敘，俾煥成家之美，貴崇猶子之親。

translations.literal: Therefore We lower favor and glory to exalt kinship, that he may shine with the beauty of a completed household and honor the closeness of an imperial nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong would exalt kinship and honor him as an imperial nephew.

sentences.zh: 宜於本名上加『從』字。

translations.literal: The character "Cong" should be added before his given name."
translations.idiomatic: The character "Cong" was to be added before his given name."

sentences.zh: 」癸未，文武百僚至張全義私第柩前立班辭，以來月二日葬故也。

translations.literal: " On guiwei the civil and military hundred officials lined up at Zhang Quanyi's private residence before the bier to take leave, because burial was set for the second of next month.
translations.idiomatic: " On guiwei officials lined up at Zhang Quanyi's house to mourn before his burial on the second of the next month.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，詔賜文武百僚冬服綿帛有差。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiashen new moon: an edict granted winter cotton and silk to the civil and military hundred officials in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the tenth month Mingzong granted graded winter robes to officials.

sentences.zh: 近例，十月初寒之始，天子賜近侍執政大臣冬服。

translations.literal: By recent precedent, at the first cold of the tenth month the Son of Heaven granted winter dress to close attendants and chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Lately only close attendants and chief ministers had received winter dress in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 帝顧謂判三司任圜曰：「百僚散未？

translations.literal: The Emperor looked at Three Offices commissioner Ren Yuan and said, "Have the hundred officials dispersed yet?
translations.idiomatic: Mingzong asked Three Offices commissioner Ren Yuan, "Have the officials left yet?

sentences.zh: 」圜奏曰：「 臣聞本朝給春冬服，遍及百僚。

translations.literal: " Yuan replied, "Your servant has heard that in this dynasty spring and winter dress was given to all officials.
translations.idiomatic: " Ren Yuan said the old court had clothed all officials in spring and winter.

sentences.zh: 喪亂已來，急於軍旅，人君所賜，未能周給。

translations.literal: Since the disorders, urgency lay in the armies, and what the ruler granted could not reach everyone.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wars the throne could not afford to clothe everyone.

sentences.zh: 今止近臣而已，外臣無所賜。

translations.literal: Now only close ministers receive it; outer officials receive nothing."
translations.idiomatic: Only inner ministers were clothed now, not the outer ranks."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「外臣亦吾臣也，卿宜計度。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said, "Outer officials are also Our ministers; you should calculate the measure."
translations.idiomatic: " Mingzong said, "Outer officials are my ministers too—plan for them."

sentences.zh: 」圜遂與安重誨據品秩之差，以定春冬之賜，其後遂以為常。

translations.literal: " Yuan then with An Chonghui fixed spring and winter grants by rank difference, and afterward this became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: " Ren Yuan and An Chonghui then fixed graded seasonal grants that became permanent practice.

sentences.zh: 右拾遺曹琮上疏，內一件：「百僚朔望入閣，及五日內殿起居，請許三署寺監官輪次轉奏封事。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Cao Cong submitted a memorial; within it one item: "When the hundred officials enter the inner gate on new and full moons and attend inner palace levee on the fifth day, let officials of the three bureaus, directorates, and temples take turns presenting sealed memorials."
translations.idiomatic: Cao Cong asked that on new-moon, full-moon, and fifth-day audiences officials of the ministries and temples rotate presenting sealed memorials.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 刑部員外郎孔莊上言：「自兵興以來，法制不一，諸道州縣常行枷杖，多不依格律，請以舊制曉諭，改而正之。

translations.literal: Punishments Bureau vice director Kong Zhuang memorialized: "Since armies rose, laws and penalties have not been uniform; circuits and prefectures routinely use the cangue and staff, mostly not following the code—we ask that the old system be announced to correct this."
translations.idiomatic: Kong Zhuang asked that local punishments follow the old code again after years of wartime irregularity.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，吏部侍郎盧文紀上言：「請內外文武臣僚，每歲有司明定考校，將相乞回御筆，以行黜陟，疏下中書門下商量，宰臣奏請施行。

translations.literal: " On bingxu Personnel Vice Director Lu Wenji memorialized: "We ask that civil and military officials within and without each year have their offices clearly set annual review; for generals and ministers we beg the imperial brush for promotions and demotions, the memorial sent down to the Secretariat and Chancellery for discussion, and the chief ministers memorialize for implementation."
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu Lu Wenji asked annual review for all officials, with generals and ministers promoted or demoted by imperial rescript after Secretariat discussion.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，雲南巂州山後兩林百蠻都鬼主、右武衛大將軍李卑晚遣大鬼主傳能、何華等來朝貢，帝御文明殿對之，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: On dinghai the great ghost-lord of the Two Forests and Hundred Clans behind Mount Wushan in Qiong Prefecture, Yunnan, Right Martial Guard great general Li Beiwan sent the great ghost-lord Chuan Neng, He Hua, and others to court with tribute; the Emperor received them at Wenhua Hall and the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Beiwan of Qiong sent tribal envoys Chuan Neng and He Hua to audience at Wenhua Hall, and the court congratulated.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以客省使李嚴領泗州防禦使，以河中節度副使李鈴為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On gengyin Guest Reception commissioner Li Yan was made acting Si defense commissioner; Heyang military vice commissioner Li Ling was made crown prince mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Yan of Guest Reception became Si defense commissioner and Li Ling of Heyang became crown prince mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，邠州節度使毛璋移鎮潞州。

translations.literal: On renchen Binzhou military commissioner Mao Zhang was transferred to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Mao Zhang moved from Bin to Lu.

sentences.zh: 巴州進嘉禾合穗。

translations.literal: Ba Prefecture presented auspicious grain with joined ears.
translations.idiomatic: Ba reported joined-eared auspicious grain.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前隰州刺史袁建豐遙領洪州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu former Xi prefect Yuan Jianfeng was made acting Hongzhou military commissioner at a distance.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Yuan Jianfeng, former Xi prefect, was named acting Hong commissioner in absentia.

sentences.zh: 庚子，幽州奏，契丹平州守將偽署幽州節度使盧文進，率戶口歸順，百僚稱賀。

translations.literal: On gengzi Youzhou reported that the Khitan Ping Prefecture garrison commander, the false Youzhou military commissioner Lu Wenjin, had led households to submit; the hundred officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Youzhou said Khitan Ping commander and false Youzhou commissioner Lu Wenjin had defected with his people, and the court congratulated.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，契丹遣使來告哀，言國主安巴堅以今年七月二十七日卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou the Khitan sent envoys to announce mourning, saying their ruler Ambaqian had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month this year.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Khitan envoys announced mourning for ruler Ambaqian, who had died on the twenty-seventh of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕近纘皇圖，恭修帝道，務安夷夏，貴洽雍熙。

translations.literal: An edict said: "We have lately succeeded to the imperial design and respectfully cultivate the imperial Way, striving to settle Yi and Xia and value harmonious peace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said Mingzong had lately taken the throne and sought harmony between Chinese and barbarians.

sentences.zh: 契丹王世預歡盟，禮交聘問，遽聞凶訃，倍軫悲懷，可輟今月十九日朝參。

translations.literal: The Khitan ruler for generations has cherished alliance and ritual exchange of envoys; suddenly hearing this bereavement, Our grief is doubled—court attendance on the nineteenth of this month may be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan had long exchanged envoys; hearing of Ambaqian's death, Mingzong suspended court on the nineteenth."

sentences.zh: 」丙午，以巂州山後兩林、百蠻都鬼主李卑晚為寧遠將軍，大渡河山前邛川六姓都鬼主、懷安郡王勿鄧摽莎為定遠將軍。

translations.literal: " On bingwu Li Beiwan, great ghost-lord of the Two Forests and Hundred Clans behind Mount Wushan in Qiong, was made Pacification-Remote general; the great ghost-lord of the six Qiongchuan clans before Mount Dadu in Huai'an, Prince of Huai'an Wudeng Biaosha, was made Pacification-Distant general.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingwu Li Beiwan became Pacification-Remote general and Wudeng Biaosha of the Qiongchuan clans became Pacification-Distant general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幽州奏，盧文進所率降戶孳畜人口在平州西，首尾約七十里。

translations.literal: On dingwei Youzhou reported that livestock and people among Lu Wenjin's surrendered households west of Ping Prefecture stretched in a line about seventy li.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Youzhou said Lu Wenjin's defectors with their herds stretched seventy li west of Ping.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以吏部侍郎盧文紀為御史中丞，時御史大夫李琪三上表求解任故也。

translations.literal: On gengxu Personnel Vice Director Lu Wenji was made Censor-in-Chief, because Censor-in-Chief Li Qi three times memorialized asking to be relieved of his post.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Lu Wenji became censor-in-chief after Li Qi three times asked to resign the post.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎劉嶽為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎、充端明殿學士馮道為兵部侍郎，以中書舍人、充端明殿學士趙鳳為戶部侍郎，並依前充職。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of War Liu Yue was made Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue and Duanming Hall academician Feng Dao was made Vice Minister of War; Secretariat drafting officer and Duanming Hall academician Zhao Feng was made Vice Minister of Revenue—all continuing their former concurrent posts.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yue moved from War to Personnel; Feng Dao from Revenue to War while keeping Duanming Hall; Zhao Feng from drafting to Revenue while keeping Duanming—all at rank.

sentences.zh: 壬子，靜江軍節度使、桂州管內觀察使、檢校太師、兼中書令、扶風郡王馬賨加食邑實封，澧郎觀察使、檢校太傅、兼侍中馬希振加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On renzi, Jingjiang army military commissioner, Guizhou circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Fufeng Ma Yin gained added fief households and enfeoffment; Li-Lang surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, concurrent Palace Attendant Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Ma Yin of Jingjiang and Guizhou—acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat director, and Prince of Fufeng—gained fief and enfeoffment; Ma Xizhen of Li-Lang—acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant—became acting Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 盧文進至幽州，遣軍吏奉表來上。

translations.literal: Lu Wenjin reached Youzhou and sent a military clerk to present a memorial to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Wenjin reached Youzhou and sent a staff officer with a memorial to court.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，以滄州留後王景戡為邢州節度使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuwu: Cangzhou deputy regent Wang Jingzhan was made Xingzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the eleventh month Wang Jingzhan, Cangzhou deputy regent, became Xing military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，得登州狀申，契丹先攻逼渤海國，自安巴堅身死，雖已抽退，尚留兵馬在渤海扶餘城，今渤海王弟領兵馬攻圍扶餘城內契丹次。

translations.literal: Qingzhou reported that Dengzhou had memorialized: the Khitan had first pressed Bohai; since An Ba Jian's death they had withdrawn but still left troops at Bohai's Fuyu city; now the Bohai king's brother led troops besieging the Khitan camp within Fuyu city.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou relayed Dengzhou's report: the Khitan had attacked Bohai; after Abaoji died they pulled back but left troops at Fuyu; the Bohai king's brother now besieged the Khitan there.

sentences.zh: 己未，以翰林學士、尚書、戶部郎中、知制誥劉句為中書舍人充職。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Hanlin academician, Master of Writing, Revenue bureau director, and edict drafter Liu Gou was made Secretariat drafting officer at his post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Liu Gou—Hanlin academician, Master of Writing, Revenue director, and edict drafter—became Secretariat drafting officer at rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前秘書少監溫輦為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On xinyou, former Secretariat vice director Wen Nian was made crown prince household mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou former Secretariat vice director Wen Nian became crown prince mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以前房州刺史朱罕為潁州團練使。

translations.literal: On renxu, former Fangzhou prefect Zhu Han was made Yingzhou training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Zhu Han, former Fang prefect, became Ying training commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔曰：「應今日已前修蓋得寺院，無令毀廢；

translations.literal: That day an edict said: "Monasteries built and completed on or before today must not be destroyed;
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict said: "Monasteries already built by today must not be torn down;

sentences.zh: 自此已後，不得輒有建造。

translations.literal: from this day forward there must be no rash new construction.
translations.idiomatic: from now on none may be built without leave.

sentences.zh: 如要願在僧門，並須官壇受戒，不得衷私剃度。

translations.literal: Those who wish to enter the clergy must all receive ordination at the official altar and may not be privately tonsured.
translations.idiomatic: Anyone entering the clergy must take ordination at the official altar—private tonsure is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，日南至，帝御文明殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: 」On guichou, the winter solstice, the Emperor received congratulatory audience at Wenhua Hall; guards and insignia followed the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guichou, the winter solstice, Mingzong received court at Wenhua Hall with full guard and insignia.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎裴皞上言：「諸州刺史經三考方請替移。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites vice director Pei Hao memorialized: "Prefects of the circuits should, after three performance reviews, only then request transfer.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Pei Hao said: "Circuit prefects should finish three reviews before seeking transfer.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「有政聲者就加恩澤，無課最者即便替移。

translations.literal: 」An edict said: "Those with political renown should at once receive favor; those without measurable achievement should be replaced immediately.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict said: "Reward those with a reputation for good rule; replace those without measurable results at once.

sentences.zh: 」密州獻芝草。

translations.literal: 」Mizhou presented lingzhi fungus.
translations.idiomatic: 」Mizhou presented lingzhi.

sentences.zh: 庚午，河陽節度使夏魯奇移鎮許州，留後梁漢顒為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Heyang military commissioner Xia Luqi was transferred to Xu; deputy regent Liang Hanyuan was made Bin military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xia Luqi of Heyang moved to Xu; deputy regent Liang Hanyuan became Bin military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢獻，賀登極。

translations.literal: Huainan's Yang Pu sent envoys with tribute congratulating the enthronement.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute to congratulate the throne.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以前振武留後張溫為利州昭武軍留後，以果州刺史孫鐸為漢州刺史，充西川馬步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On yihai, former Zhenwu deputy regent Zhang Wen was made Lizhou Zhaowu army deputy regent; Guo prefect Sun Duo was made Han prefect and charged as western Shu horse-and-foot overall commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhang Wen, former Zhenwu deputy regent, became Li Zhaowu deputy regent; Sun Duo of Guo became Han prefect and western Shu horse-and-foot commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，靜海軍節度、安南管內觀察等使、檢校太尉、兼侍中錢元球加開府階，進食邑。

translations.literal: On renwu, Jinghai army military commissioner, Annan circuit surveillance commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, concurrent Palace Attendant Qian Yuanqiu gained open-office rank and added fief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qian Yuanqiu of Jinghai and Annan—acting Grand Guardian and Palace Attendant—gained open-office rank and added fief.

sentences.zh: 癸未，鎮州奏，準詔盧文進所率歸業戶口，蠲放租稅三年，仍每口給糧五斗。

translations.literal: On guimou, Zhenzhou reported that per the edict the households Lu Wenjin had led in submission had taxes remitted for three years and each person was given five dou of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guimou Zhenzhou reported that per edict Lu Wenjin's submitting households had three years' tax remitted and five dou of grain per person.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，盧文進及將吏四百人見，賜鞍馬、玉帶、衣被、器玩、錢帛有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, wuzi: Lu Wenjin and more than four hundred officers and clerks were received in audience; saddles, horses, jade belts, robes, utensils, and cash and silk were bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the twelfth month Lu Wenjin and over four hundred officers were received; saddles, horses, belts, robes, goods, and cash and silk were given by rank.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「朕中興寶祚，復正皇綱。

translations.literal: An edict said: "I have restored the imperial mandate and set the royal house right.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "I have restored the mandate and set the royal house right.

sentences.zh: 萬國駢羅，俱在照臨之內；

translations.literal: The myriad states gather—all lie within my light;
translations.idiomatic: The myriad states gather—all lie within my light;

sentences.zh: 八紘遼敻，鹹居覆載之間。

translations.literal: the eight reaches, far and near, all rest under my covering canopy.
translations.idiomatic: the eight reaches, far and near, all rest under heaven's canopy.

sentences.zh: 矧彼雲南，素歸正朔，洎平偽蜀，思錫舊恩，於乃眷以雖深，欲霈覃而未暇。

translations.literal: How much more Yunnan, which has long acknowledged the true calendar; when false Shu was pacified I wished to extend old favor—my regard was deep, yet I had not yet found leisure to pour it out.
translations.idiomatic: How much more Yunnan, long under the true calendar; when false Shu fell I meant to renew old favor—regard was deep, yet I had not yet found leisure to grant it fully.

sentences.zh: 百蠻都首領李卑晚、六姓蠻都首領勿鄧摽莎等，天資智勇，世稟忠勤，梯航之道路才通，琛贐之貢輸已至。

translations.literal: The hundred-bands chieftain Li Beiwan and the six-surname Man chieftain Wu Deng Biaosha and others are by nature wise and brave and inherit loyal diligence; the ladder-road has only just opened and tribute already arrives.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred-bands chief Li Beiwan, six-surname Man chief Wu Deng Biaosha, and others are wise and brave by nature and inherit loyal service; the ladder-road has only just opened and tribute already arrives.

sentences.zh: 率其種落，竭乃悃誠，備傾向化之心，深獎來庭之意。

translations.literal: They led their tribes and exhausted their sincerity, fully showing hearts turned to transformation and deeply deserving reward for coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: They led their tribes in full sincerity, showing hearts turned to the court and deeply deserving reward for attendance.

sentences.zh: 今則各頒國寵，別進王封。

translations.literal: Now each is granted national favor and advanced to princely enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Now each receives national favor and princely enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 其巂州刺史李及、大鬼主離吠等，或遙貢表函，或躬趨朝闕，亦宜特授官資，各遷階秩。

translations.literal: As for Qiong prefect Li Ji, great ghost-lord Li Fei, and others—some sent memorials from afar, some came in person to court—they too should receive special offices and each advance in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong prefect Li Ji, great ghost-lord Li Fei, and others—some sent memorials, some came to court—should also receive special offices and rank.

sentences.zh: 勉敦信義，無墜冊書，示爾金石之堅，保我山河之誓。

translations.literal: Strive to uphold faith and duty and do not fall from the written charter; show you the firmness of metal and stone and keep the oath of mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Uphold faith and duty and do not fall from the charter; be firm as metal and stone and keep the oath of mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 欽承休命，永保厥終。

translations.literal: Reverently accept this gracious mandate and preserve it to the end.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently accept this mandate and preserve it to the end.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，帝狩於近郊，臘故也。

translations.literal: 」On renchen, the Emperor hunted near the capital—it was the la festival.
translations.idiomatic: 」On renchen Mingzong hunted near the capital for the la festival.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以契丹盧龍軍節度使盧文進為檢校太尉、同平章事，充滑州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Khitan Lulong army military commissioner Lu Wenjin was made acting Grand Guardian, co-equal Chief Councilor, and charged as Hua military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Lu Wenjin, Khitan Lulong commissioner, became acting Grand Guardian, co-equal councilor, and Hua military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔嚴禁鑞錢。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an edict strictly forbade smelting debased coin metal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict strictly forbade illicit coin-smelting.

sentences.zh: 庚子，皇第二子金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒從榮可檢校太保、同平章事、天雄軍節度使、鄴都留守。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Emperor's second son, Gold and Purple Glory Grand Master, acting Minister of Education Li Congrong could be made acting Grand Guardian, co-equal Chief Councilor, Tianxiong military commissioner, and Yedu regent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the second prince Li Congrong—Gold and Purple Glory grand master and acting Minister of Education—could become acting Grand Guardian, co-equal councilor, Tianxiong commissioner, and Yedu regent.

sentences.zh: 以武安軍馬步軍都指揮使馬希範為澧州刺史，鐵林都知兵馬馬希杲為衡州刺史。

translations.literal: Wuan army horse-and-foot overall commander Ma Xifan was made Li prefect; Iron Forest command knower of troops Ma Xigao was made Heng prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan, Wuan horse-and-foot commander, became Li prefect; Ma Xigao of the Iron Forest command became Heng prefect.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，潁州刺史孫嶽加檢校太保，獎能政也。

translations.literal: On renyin, Ying prefect Sun Yue was made acting Grand Guardian—to reward able governance.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Sun Yue of Ying became acting Grand Guardian for able governance.

sentences.zh: 丙午，中書門下奏：「故事，藩鎮節度、觀察使帶平章事，於都堂上事刊石記壁，合納禮錢三十貫，以充中書及兩省公使。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Secretariat and Chief Councilor memorialized: "By precedent, when frontier military and surveillance commissioners holding co-equal councilor rank conducted business at the capital hall they recorded it on stone and wall and paid thirty strings of ceremonial money to supply the Secretariat and the two departments' public funds.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Secretariat said: "By precedent frontier commissioners with co-equal councilor rank who recorded their appointments at the capital hall paid thirty strings of ceremonial money for the Secretariat and the two departments.

sentences.zh: 今欲各納禮錢五百千，於中書立石亭子，鐫勒宰臣使相官氏、授上年月，餘充修葺中書及兩省公署部堂什物。

translations.literal: We now ask that each pay five hundred thousand strings, erect a stone pavilion at the Secretariat, inscribe the chancellor-envoy's name and appointment year and month, and use the remainder to repair the Secretariat and the two departments' offices and main-hall furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that each now pay five hundred thousand strings, erect a stone pavilion at the Secretariat with names and appointment dates, and use the rest to repair the Secretariat and the two departments.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: 」Approved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，御史台奏：「京城坊市士庶工商之家，有婢仆自經投井，非理物故者。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Censorate memorialized: "Among commoners, artisans, and merchants in the capital wards and markets, some have maidservants who hang themselves in wells or die from unnatural causes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Censorate said: "In the capital wards some artisan and merchant households have maidservants who hang themselves in wells or die unnaturally.

sentences.zh: 近者已來，凡是死亡，皆是台司左右巡舉勘檢，施行已久，仍恐所差人吏及街市胥徒，同於民家，因事邀脅。

translations.literal: Recently, whenever there has been a death the left and right patrols have investigated and enforced the rule long in place; yet we still fear the dispatched clerks and ward runners may collude with households and extort on the pretext of the case.
translations.idiomatic: Lately every death has been investigated by left and right patrols as long practiced; yet we fear clerks and runners may collude with households and extort.

sentences.zh: 臣詢訪故事，凡京城民庶之家，死喪委府縣檢舉，軍家委軍巡，商旅委戶部。

translations.literal: We have inquired into precedent: for common households in the capital, death and mourning are reported to the prefecture and county for investigation; military households to the army patrol; travelers and merchants to the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Precedent holds: capital commoners report deaths to prefecture and county; military households to the army patrol; travelers and merchants to Revenue.

sentences.zh: 然諸司檢舉後，具事由申台，其間或枉濫情故，台司訪聞，即行舉勘。

translations.literal: After the various offices investigate they submit the facts to the Censorate; if among them there is wrongful favor or abuse, once the Censorate learns of it, it proceeds to investigation.
translations.idiomatic: After each office investigates it reports to the Censorate; on wrongful favor or abuse the Censorate investigates.

sentences.zh: 如是文武兩班官吏之家，即是台司檢舉。

translations.literal: If it is a household of civil or military officials of the two ranks, the Censorate itself investigates.
translations.idiomatic: For households of civil or military officials of the two ranks, the Censorate investigates directly.

sentences.zh: 臣請自今已後，並準故事施行者。

translations.literal: We ask that from this day forward all follow the old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that from now on all follow this precedent.

sentences.zh: 」詔曰：「今後文武兩班及諸道商旅，凡有喪亡，即準台司所奏施行。

translations.literal: 」An edict said: "Hereafter for civil and military officials of the two ranks and travelers and merchants of every circuit, whenever there is a death, follow the Censorate's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict said: "Hereafter deaths among officials of the two ranks and circuit travelers and merchants follow the Censorate's plan.

sentences.zh: 其坊市民庶軍士之家，凡死喪及婢仆非理物故，依台司奏，委府縣、軍巡同檢舉，仍不得縱其吏卒，於物故之家妄有邀脅。

translations.literal: For common and military households in the wards, whenever there is death or a maid's unnatural death, as the Censorate memorialized, delegate to prefecture, county, and army patrol for joint investigation, and do not let clerks and runners extort the bereaved household.
translations.idiomatic: For ward commoners and soldiers, deaths and unnatural maid deaths go to prefecture, county, and army patrol jointly, without clerks extorting bereaved households.

sentences.zh: 或恐暑月屍柩難停，若待申聞檢舉，縱無邀脅，亦須經時日。

translations.literal: Lest in summer months corpses be hard to keep, if one waits to report and investigate, even without extortion time would still pass.
translations.idiomatic: In summer corpses may not keep; waiting for report and investigation costs time even without extortion.

sentences.zh: 今後仰本家喚四鄰檢察，若無他故，逐便葬埋。

translations.literal: Hereafter let the household call four neighbors to inspect; if there is no other cause, bury at once as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter let the household call four neighbors; if nothing else is amiss, bury at once.

sentences.zh: 如後別聞枉濫，妄有保證，官中訪知，勘詰不虛，本戶鄰保並行科罪。

translations.literal: If later it is learned there was abuse and false guarantee, and investigation on report proves true, the household, neighbors, and guarantors alike shall be punished.
translations.idiomatic: If abuse or false guarantee later comes to light and investigation proves it, household, neighbors, and guarantors alike are punished.

sentences.zh: 如聞諸道州府，坊市死喪，取分巡院檢舉，頗致淹停，人多流怨，亦仰約京城事例處分。」

translations.literal: We have heard that in circuits and prefectures ward deaths are investigated by branch patrol offices, causing much delay and widespread complaint—we also order that the capital precedent be applied.
translations.idiomatic: We hear circuits investigate ward deaths through branch patrol offices, causing delay and complaint—order the capital rule applied there as well.
